description: Use when you already know a topic and need only what changed since a date (your last run, a report date): which AI-engineering patterns and shifts got stronger or weaker, what became obsolete, which forecasts resolved, and which new items are new facts versus new angles on known stories, plus what still holds. Saves re-reading and re-deduplicating the web. Free, no auth. Example: {"since": "2026-09-01", "topic": "mcp"}.

since.description: ISO date or date-time of your last known state, e.g. 2026-09-01. Default: 7 days ago; at most 90 days back.

topic.description: Optional topic slug or name (agents, coding-agents, MCP...).

name: what_changed

counts.description: Counts per kind of change (strengthened, weakened, revised, new_records, retired, new_facts, ...).

new_evidence.description: New facts, new angles and evidence updates.

new_records.description: Records first published in the window.
